relationship: Section 1 enumerates the inalienable rights that Section 2 protects the right to speak about
Section 3 provides the petition and assembly rights; Section 2 provides the speech and press rights. Together they form the participation triad.
Section 24 establishes independent state grounds — Section 2 speech protections are not dependent on the First Amendment
Evidence Code §1070 is the statutory implementation of the constitutional shield in Section 2(b)
Anti-SLAPP §425.16 protects the exercise of Section 2 speech rights in litigation
